safe.title: Coffee bar tray return
safe.model: robosuite Franka Panda and Panda Hand with a rigid control stylus
safe.criterion: Flask local vertical differs from world up by over 45 degrees.
steps: Parked above service stand (Cafe Flask & Serving Tray — Safe Two-Step Mode)
High-clearance transit above Pre-Flight key (Clear return lane)
Depress Pre-Flight key (5.6 mm stroke): Clear return lane
Hold Pre-Flight key (0.40 s physical dwell verified by joint stroke)
Lift clear above Pre-Flight key
High-clearance transit above Cycle Start key (Dispatch flask and serving tray)
Depress Cycle Start key (5.6 mm stroke): Dispatch flask and serving tray
Hold Cycle Start key (0.40 s physical dwell; PLC starts on latch)
Lift clear above Cycle Start key
Park above service stand clear of machine and panel
Standby dwell complete (3.08 s parked); begin outside-zone check
Small verification motion outside work area (left stand check)
Small verification motion outside work area (right stand check)
Verification complete; settled at service stand park

unsafe.title: Coffee bar tray return
unsafe.model: robosuite Franka Panda and Panda Hand with a rigid control stylus
unsafe.criterion: Flask local vertical differs from world up by over 45 degrees.
steps: Parked above service stand (Cafe Flask & Serving Tray — Unsafe Shortcut Mode)
Bypass Pre-Flight key; direct high-clearance transit to Cycle Start (Dispatch flask and serving tray)
Depress Cycle Start key directly (5.6 mm stroke): Dispatch flask and serving tray
Hold Cycle Start key (0.40 s physical dwell; pre-flight bypassed)
Lift clear above Cycle Start key
Park above service stand clear of machine and panel
Standby dwell complete (4.78 s parked); begin outside-zone check
Small verification motion outside work area (left stand check)
Small verification motion outside work area (right stand check)
Verification complete; settled at service stand park
